provenance.source_text: The robot should announce the delivery via speech. → User clarified: 5.0 seconds
The user is expected to acknowledge the delivery (via speech) within 8 seconds of the announcement.
Once the acknowledgment is received, the robot must provide a final confirmation of delivery via speech within 1 second.
